---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for ExamShield
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 💭 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## 📊 Use Case

Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

**Example**:
```
When monitoring a large exam hall with 50 students...
```

## 🎨 Mock-ups/Examples

If applicable, add sketches, mock-ups, or examples from other projects.

## 📈 Impact

How many users would benefit from this feature?
- [ ] Few users (niche use case)
- [ ] Some users (specific scenario)
- [ ] Many users (common need)
- [ ] All users (core functionality)

## ⏱️ Urgency

How urgent is this feature?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would improve workflow
- [ ] Important for production use
- [ ] Blocking / Critical

## ✔️ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing feature requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with ExamShield's goals
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature
